title: Bank System
summary: Persistent gold account. On-ship gold (pl.gold) is at risk (lost on sink or full reset). Banked gold (pl.bank) survives. Docking sweeps on-ship gold into the bank; all docked transactions spend from the bank.

decisions.hud_bank_line: NONE — no persistent bank line item in the left HUD panel (per Noah).
decisions.dock_menu_money: Dock menu GOLD figure reads pl.bank (the spendable balance).
decisions.refactor_scope: FULL registry refactor (Events + SystemRegistry + GameScene hooks + Combat SHIP_HIT/SHIP_SUNK). Behavior-preserving; makes Zoom/Weather/Docks near drop-in next.
decisions.deposit_popup: KEEP — transient '+Xg BANKED' world popup on docking deposit.
decisions.partial_spend: Preserved — repair/restock spend as much as the bank can afford (partial allowed), matching prior gold behavior.
decisions.save_version: No VERSION bump — bank read with a numeric fallback so pre-bank saves still load.

data_shape.pl.bank: number — banked gold. Initialized to 0 in BankSystem.init (idempotent). Serialized by SaveSystem. Carried across resetGame().

files_new.purpose: EV event-name constants for the scene event bus (DOCK_ENTERED, SHIP_HIT, SHIP_SUNK, ...).
Systems registry (init/update/draw/onDock) + registerSystems() declaring active feature systems. BankSystem registered.
Bank logic: init(pl.bank), deposit on DOCK_ENTERED, spend(), credit().

files_changed.change: Add 3 <script> tags: core/Events.js + core/SystemRegistry.js right after constants.js; systems/BankSystem.js after SaveSystem.js (before scenes).

create(): registerSystems()+Systems.init(this) before the save-load block. dock branch: emit EV.DOCK_ENTERED + Systems.onDock BEFORE Save.write. update(): Systems.update before draw. draw(): Systems.draw(this, gw). repairAtPort/restockAtPort: spend from pl.bank. resetGame(): carry pl.bank across Player.create.
onHit(): emit EV.SHIP_HIT each hit and EV.SHIP_SUNK on a kill.
serialize: include bank. apply: restore p.bank with numeric fallback for old saves.
Dock menu money figure reads pl.bank (no new persistent HUD line).

acceptance_criteria: On docking, on-ship gold moves to pl.bank and a '+Xg BANKED' popup shows.
Repair and restock deduct from pl.bank; 'NO GOLD' shows only when the bank can't cover even a partial buy.
Dock menu GOLD figure reflects the bank balance.
Banked gold survives a full reset (Esc -> Reset Game) and a sink.
Save -> reload (localStorage and file import) restores pl.bank; pre-bank saves still load (bank kept).
With no feature systems beyond Bank registered, sailing/combat/world behave exactly as before.
No persistent bank line item appears in the left HUD panel.
Every touched JS file passes node --check.
